source: relit from wren_healthy.png (64x64); lantern flame centre at (34.5,58)
note: Portrait shown in Wren's party slot; swap by lantern state. Health-state portraits (wounded/near_death) still apply when lantern is bright; when guttering/out the lantern portrait takes priority unless near_death.

bright.desc: warm orange glow on face/hood, lantern bright

gutter.desc: dimmer, unsteady warm light; frame 2 is the dip, frame 3 the flare

flicker.rule: each tick pick a frame != current; weights 1:0.5:0.8 (1:2:3); every 1-3 s hold frame 2 for 3-5 ticks (sputter, sync the sputter sfx)

out.desc: cold green-blue shadowed face, lantern glass dark, faint smoke wisp

ember.desc: 0 oil, ember only: small blue-white glow low in the lantern glass, face in cold dim light

pulse.rule: slow breathing glow; optional (static frame 1 is fine)

transitions.gutter->out: show gutter_2 for 2 ticks then cut to out
transitions.bright->ember: gutter_2 for 2 ticks, then ember (sync sfx_lantern_sputter)
transitions.ember->bright: gutter_3 for 1 tick, then bright (oil added)

oilStates.note: Pick Wren's portrait by oil (max 4). oil>=1 -> bright (wren_lantern_bright.png = lantern lit with oil). oil==0 -> ember. gutter/out are kept for scripted moments (lantern dying, doused).
oilStates.priority: near_death portrait overrides both; otherwise lantern state overrides healthy/wounded
